verdict.rationale: Datadog documents OpenTelemetry support and a public API reference, which could theoretically be used to extract data in a standard format, but there is no documentation of a bulk/full data export mechanism or guarantee of open-format portability for leaving the platform. Community evidence shows customers migrating away (e.g., to Grafana) but doesn't confirm a clean open-format export process. missing for 10: explicit data export/portability docs, bulk export tooling, confirmation that historical metrics/logs/traces can be fully extracted in open formats without vendor lock-in.
